title: Las Vegas Food Tour: Chinatown Favorites & Hidden Gems
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is more than a food tour. It is a guided exploration of one of Las Vegas's most exciting neighborhoods, combining incredible food with the stories, culture, and people that make Chinatown so special.

Located just minutes from the Las Vegas Strip, Chinatown has become one of the city's most vibrant dining destinations. Along the way, you'll visit a carefully selected mix of local favorites and hidden gems while learning how the neighborhood evolved into a culinary hotspot. Each stop has been chosen not just for the food, but for the story behind it.

With small groups and an experienced guide leading the way, you'll get a more personal experience, plenty of opportunities to ask questions, and a deeper understanding of the neighborhood than you could get by exploring on your own.

Come hungry, leave with a full stomach, and discover a side of Las Vegas that many visitors never experience.
